testResults.name: strategy-bundles-and-artifact-import
testResults.result: 8 tests passed for content-addressed source/config/dependency identity, sandbox handoff, hash/size verification, immutable workspace import, provenance links, and fenced Git publication.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed with confined paths, injected Git/filesystem boundaries, and no network access.

decisions: Strategy source is normalized and hashed as an immutable bundle before sandbox validation.
Only reproducibility-critical artifacts are imported, each under a content-addressed path with manifest, workflow, experiment, strategy, and Git provenance.
